skills.description: Using fixed cameras at home (living room, bedroom) of elderly people living alone, the system analyzes daily videos and detects negative behavior indicators during solo time: dazing (long-duration motionless gazing without purposeful action), sighing (rapid chest rise-and-fall with audible expiration), and self-talking (mouth movement without any conversation partner). It counts the frequency and duration of these behaviors and comprehensively evaluates the elder's emotional risk level (low / medium / high). The skill assists family members or community workers in understanding the elder's mental state and timely providing emotional care or psychological intervention. Application scenarios: homes of solo-living elders, nursing homes, community daycare centers. The system generates a daily emotional-risk report; when the risk level is 'medium' or 'high', it pushes reminders. Skill features: loneliness and depression in the elderly are common mental-health issues, and early behavioral signals are often overlooked. AI automatic monitoring of dazing / sighing / self-talking helps family members detect mental abnormalities early, intervene promptly, and improve the elder's quality of life. Can be integrated into home-care cameras or community health-management platforms. | 通过独居老人在家中的固定摄像头（如客厅、卧室），分析日常视频，检测独处期间的消极行为指标：发呆（长时间静止注视，缺乏目的性动作）、叹气（胸部快速起伏伴呼气声）、自言自语（口部活动但无对话对象）等。统计这些行为的发生频次和持续时间，综合评估老年人潜在的情绪风险等级（低/中/高）。该技能可辅助家属或社区工作者了解老人心理状态，及时进行情感关怀或心理干预。应用场景：独居老人家庭、养老院、社区日间照料中心。系统每日生成情绪风险报告，当风险等级为'中'或'高'时推送提醒。技能特点：老年人孤独和抑郁是常见的心理健康问题，早期行为信号常被忽视。通过AI自动监测发呆、叹气、自言自语等行为，可辅助家属及早发现心理异常，及时干预，提高老年人生活质量。该技能可集成到居家养老摄像头或社区健康管理平台中。

skills.description: 茶·酒·咖啡——三大日常兴奋剂的取舍、时机、剂量、人群适配（致敬《茶经》《酒经》中国古典命名风格）
skills.description_zh:
如果你每天都在喝这三样东西，你需要先了解它们的科学。

详细介绍
你是否也困惑过：

☕ 早晨该喝咖啡还是茶？
🌙 晚上喝了红茶为什么睡不着？
🍷 适度饮酒真的对心脏好吗？
📱 刷手机和喝酒哪个危害更大？
💊 能量饮料到底是不是智商税？
「茶酒咖啡经」基于 20+ 项 2024-2026 最新大规模研究（Frontiers 2025、NHANES、JAMA 2026、WHO 2025 等），用反直觉的视角为你解答这些问题。

三大发现
1. 酒的传统比你想象更古老——但 WHO 2025 说"没有安全水平"

13,000 年前人类就开始酿酒——最初是为了解决"水不安全"
中世纪啤酒酒精度仅 0.75%，本质是"净化过的水"
2024-2025 多项研究推翻了"适度饮酒对心脏好"的 J 型曲线
古代的"健康酒"和今天的酒是两种东西
2. 茶的"水安全"秘密——中国人不喝冷水 700 年了

中国"喝热水"传统背后是公共卫生革命
茶=让白开水变好喝 = 客观上避开了大量水源性疾病
L-茶氨酸是茶的"护城河"——咖啡没有这层协同
3. 咖啡催生了伦敦证券交易所

17 世纪咖啡馆是"便士大学"——1 便士买一杯坐一天
任何阶层都能进——史无前例的民主知识空间
伦敦证交所、Lloyd's 保险、苏富比/佳士得都源于咖啡馆
skills.name: 茶酒咖啡经-三大日常兴奋剂的取舍、时机、剂量、人群适配

skills.description: Using a fixed indoor camera to continuously capture leaf images of houseplants from the same angle every day, AI vision techniques detect leaf color changes (green → yellow → brown), loss of glossiness (reduced surface reflectance), and formation of the abscission zone at the petiole base (angle change). Based on a time-series model over historical images, the skill predicts the risk window for leaf fall within the next 3-7 days. It helps users distinguish natural turnover from stress-induced leaf drop and adjust care in advance (raise humidity, fertilize, prune, etc.). Application scenarios: indoor potted plant care, plant rental companies, botanical garden greenhouses. The system generates a daily aging report and pushes alerts when leaf fall is imminent (e.g., 'lower leaves of lucky bamboo expected to fall in 3 days, prune in advance to keep it tidy'). Skill features: leaf aging and shedding are normal life-cycle events, but early shedding often signals environmental issues. AI fall-time prediction lets users clean up dead leaves proactively, keep plants tidy, and tune care based on predicted speed (e.g., higher humidity slows senescence).
